findings.quote: Persistent conflicts, climate emergencies, environmental degradation, growing inequalities, cyber criminality exacerbated by artificial intelligence.
findings.rationale: Identifies AI as amplifying cybercrime within global crises.

findings.quote: There is need to build a global governance architecture through multilateral negotiations that will ensure safe, secure, ethical, and inclusive use of AI.
findings.rationale: Supports multilateral AI governance, developing-country capacity and UN AI bodies.
